name: io.github.tonyyang0504/daum_ads-mcp
description: Daum search ads (now Kakao 키워드광고) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budge

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DAUM_ADS_BUSINESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Kakao business token (비즈니스 토큰) issued by POST https://kauth.kakao.com/oauth/business/token after the advertiser consents to the keyword_management scope in your biz app (https://developers.kakao.com/docs/latest/ko/business-auth/rest-api). It has no refresh flow; it expires after long non-use.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DAUM_ADS_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Kakao keyword ad account id (numeric, without the K prefix), sent as the `adAccountId` header that every campaign and report call requires.
